'''Bromi''' is a modern [[Nomai]] whose Vessel is making its way to the Gloaming Galaxy. 

When [[Canna]] sent a message to all Nomai clans that the universe was dying and that all clans should stay together, Bromi's clan told them that their Vessel is making its way to them.<ref>CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together. CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety. CANNA: If you prefer to continue exploring alone, know you will be on your own. BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you. CANNA: It’s good to hear from you, Bromi! We’ll watch for your Vessel.</ref> 

Their grandfather used to tell them the tale of the disappearance of [[Escall]]'s [[The Vessel|vessel]] as a child.<ref>BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.</ref> They considered the story to be a myth, and were shocked when [[Hyssop]] confirmed the story to be true.<ref>BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors' ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it's true, Hyssop?</ref>

==Trivia==
* Bromi may be named after the ''[[Wikipedia:Bromelia|Bromelia]]'' genus of the plant family ''[[Wikipedia:Bromeliaceae|Bromeliaceae]]''. Its species are characterized by flowers with a deeply cleft calyx.
